provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Gloomhaven: Buttons & Bugs rulebook (Cephalofair Games, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Your character card and matching miniature
Brown hit point dial to your current level's maximum HP
The ability cards listed on the back of your character card, A-side up
Brown character attack modifier tray, white cube in the topmost slot
Read the next scenario card up to and including the goal
Retrieve the monster cards from the scenario's monster list
Flip the scenario card to its map side; note terrain borders (obstacles, hazards)
Colored cubes on the monster hexes as marked
Your miniature on the starting hex
Monster card in a monster tray; white cube in its middle slot
Monster HP dials (matching cube colors) to their maximum HP
Red monster modifier tray, white cube in the topmost slot
Condition tokens, icon reference card and die nearby
Hazards deal 1 damage each time the hex is entered; ranged attacks pass over obstacles
